text_read: Whole text grepped for 月輪 and 見; samadhi section 573c10-c28 and A-syllable section 574a27-b13 read in full in Chinese.
mode_evidence: The disc is first 'contemplated' (觀白月輪) within the heart; the text then says that by this contemplation one 'illuminates and sees' (照見) the original mind, and 'I see my own mind shaped like a moon-disc' (我見自心形如月輪). The A-syllable gloss grades 'barely seeing' (纔見) versus 'constantly seeing' (常見). Whether this 見 is visual or noetic is not specified, so the crossing is claimed only by vocabulary.
onset_evidence: Starts from deliberate visualisation; no advice for one who cannot see it; prerequisite is the three secrets (body mudra, speech mantra, mind samadhi) of esoteric practice, i.e. initiation. Thresholds: a first glimpse counts as seeing ultimate truth; constant seeing marks the first bhumi.

conditions.prerequisites: Three secrets (三密) of esoteric yoga; vajra-bound mudra (金剛縛) in the A verse
conditions.other: Eight-petalled white lotus one cubit across; white-light A syllable

stages.label: 纔見 (barely seen)
stages.description: First glimpse of the round bright pure consciousness: 'seeing ultimate truth'

stages.label: 常見 (constantly seen)
stages.description: Stable seeing: entry into the first bodhisattva ground

stages.label: 廓周法界
stages.description: Gradual expansion to fill the dharmadhatu and space, contracting and extending at will

what_to_do_with_light: Stabilise, then expand to fill space and contract at will (卷舒自在).
interpretation: The moon-disc is the form of one's own mind as bodhicitta, pure and luminous like the full moon.
practice_summary: Within the heart contemplate a white moon-disc; by this, see the original mind as clear and pure, like the light of the full moon filling space without distinctions. Recognise: 'I see my own mind shaped like a moon-disc.' In the A-syllable form, with the vajra-bound mudra, contemplate an eight-petalled white lotus a cubit across with a shining white A upon it, and settle on the round bright pure consciousness. A first glimpse is counted as seeing ultimate truth; constant seeing marks the first ground; then enlarge it gradually until it fills the dharmadhatu, extending and contracting it freely.

key_passages.anchor: 祕密瑜伽，令修行者於內心中觀白月
key_passages.paraphrase: The practitioner contemplates a white moon-disc in the heart and thereby sees the original mind as pure, like full-moon light filling space.
key_passages.quote: 諸佛大悲，以善巧智說此甚深祕密瑜伽，令修行者於內心中觀白月輪。由作此觀，照見本心湛然清淨，猶如滿月光遍虛空無所分別

key_passages.anchor: 為一切有情悉含普賢之心，我見自心形
key_passages.paraphrase: 'I see my own mind shaped like a moon-disc.'

key_passages.quote: 八葉白蓮一肘門，炳現阿字素光色，禪智俱入金剛縛，召入如來寂靜智。

key_passages.anchor: 淨識。若纔見者，則名見真勝義諦。若常見
key_passages.paraphrase: Glimpsing = seeing ultimate truth; constant seeing = first ground; then expand to fill the dharmadhatu.
key_passages.quote: 當觀圓明淨識。若纔見者，則名見真勝義諦。若常見者，則入菩薩初地。若轉漸增長，則廓周法界、量等虛空、卷舒自在
